GST 01 Supply of clean, dry, white 100% 150 Kgs cotton knitted baniyan cloth wa ste/remnants, generated from g arment-manufacturing processes, in cut pieces of mixed sizes and d imensions, for use as cleaning an d wiping cloth during aircraft clea ning, maintenance and associate d workshop activities. TOTAL AMOUNT GST % Grand Total Incl. GST The item proposed for procurement is White Baniyan Cloth Waste / Remnants for Aircraft Cleaning, made of 100% cotton, with synthetic or blended fibres not being acceptable. The material shall consist of k nitted baniyan/vest fabric remnants in white colour with uniform appearance, obtained as usable leftover f abric from garment manufacturing processes and supplied in the form of cut pieces/remnants of mixed siz es and dimensions. The minimum usable piece dimensions shall be specified by AIESL before bid publicati on, based on the intended cleaning requirements and approved reference sample. The material shall be clean, dry, reusable and suitable for wiping and cleaning purposes, without being rott en, brittle, excessively worn or damaged. It shall be low-linting and shall not shed excessive fibres during normal wiping operations. The material shall be free from oil, grease, fuel, hydraulic fluid, solvents, chemi cals, paint, metal particles, dust, mould and other foreign matter, and shall not have any unpleasant, chem ical, oily or musty odour. The individual pieces shall be free from hard seams, hooks, zippers, buttons, labe ls, pins or any other attachments that may scratch or damage aircraft surfaces. The material is intended for general aircraft cleaning/wiping and associated maintenance and workshop ac tivities, subject to the applicable AIESL and aircraft maintenance procedures. The unit of measurement sha ll be Kilogram (KG). The material shall be packed in clean, dry and securely closed bags/bales to prevent contamination during storage and transportation. The supplied material shall be subjected to visual and physical inspection, comparison with the approved s

ample and net-weight verification at the designated delivery location. Acceptance shall be subject to confo rmity with the approved sample and all prescribed technical requirements. Any material found not conform ing to the specified quality parameters shall be liable for rejection. Delivery Charges must be borne by the successful bidder Delivery Address AI Engineering Services Limited MRO Complex, Near Gate 03, RGIA, Shamshabad - 500108 contact P.
